# Checklist of the grading criteria

**Repository**

- [ ] Public GitHub repository named `IEAP-Series02-RStudio`
- [ ] `main` branch up to date (graded branch)
- [ ] Clear and complete `README.md`
- [ ] `LICENSE` file
- [ ] `IEAP-Series02-Rstudio.qmd` file
- [ ] Corresponding PDF file, rendered from the final version

**Git history**

- [ ] Clear history with meaningful commit messages
- [ ] At least one commit per question of the report
- [ ] Principled use of branches (one branch per member, Pull Requests into `main`)

**Content of the notebook**

- [ ] Authors and date in the header
- [ ] Clickable link to the public GitHub repository
- [ ] Analysis of the team's workflow strategy using Git
- [ ] Analysis of the challenges encountered and lessons learned
- [ ] Complete code and answers to all questions of the "Statistical tests" section (2.1, 2.2, 2.3)
- [ ] Data sources with their URLs
- [ ] Scientific references with their DOIs

**Submission**

- [ ] PDF uploaded on Moodle
